_comment: Labels and vocabulary for the restaurant specification panel (see assets/data/restaurant-spec.json).

labels.c.note: Placeholder budgets for illustration only — not confirmed prices or quotes.

terms.coordinateMEP: Coordinate with MEP engineer / kitchen consultant
terms.oakUpholstered: Solid oak frame + upholstered seat and back
terms.flexRound: Fixed round layout; drop-leaf option TBC
terms.upholsteredPanels: Upholstered channel panels on timber frame
terms.walnutMarble: Walnut veneer carcass + honed stone top

terms.hoodSystem: Canopy hood with grease filters, make-up air
terms.hotZone: Hot zone — cooking line under hood
terms.washZone: Wash zone — dishwash, separated from food
terms.kitchenCirc: One-way flow: delivery → storage → prep → cooking → pass → wash
terms.stoneVanity: Stone top, walnut cabinet, two basins
terms.laminatedGlass: Laminated safety glass, black aluminium frame
terms.noteChairA: Comfort for 90-minute dining; light enough to move for table combinations.
terms.noteChairB: Fuller back and deeper seat for long private dinners.
terms.noteStool: Seat height matched to the 1080 mm counter (≈ 300 mm knee clearance).
terms.noteTables: Pedestal base keeps legroom free and simplifies cleaning.
terms.noteAlcove: Creates semi-private tables along the wall and absorbs sound.
terms.noteLight: Final lux levels to be verified with a lighting calculation.
terms.noteEquipment: Final selection with the kitchen consultant and the chef’s menu.
terms.noteMaterial: Samples to be approved before ordering.
terms.noteBar: Service side organised as a straight workflow: ice → glass → pour → POS.
terms.o.barVisibility: Bar visible from the whole room
